ACCOUNT_CURRENCY.description: Account Currency is the ISO 4217 currency code corresponding to the base currency of the safekeeping account.

SAFE_KEEPING_ACCOUNT.description: Account ID is an identifier for both a Cash Account and/or a Safekeeping Account that is unique within a branch.

ACTIVITY_CATEGORY.description: Activity Category is the low level description of the billable activity (e.g. Asset Services, Settlements, Tax).

ACTIVITY_CURRENCY.description: Activity Currency is the ISO 4217 currency code corresponding to the market currency of the billable activity.

ACTIVITY_TYPE.description: Activity Type is the high level description of the billable activity (e.g. Valuations, Transactions, Surcharges, Other fees).

CLARITY_BRANCH_NAME.description: Branch Name is the name of the branch for the Cash Account and/or Safekeeping Account.

CHARGE_IN_FEE_CURENCY.description: Charge (Fee Schedule Currency) is the calculated charge for the billable activity in the Fee Schedule Currency.

CHARGE_IN_USD.description: Charge (USD) is the calculated charge for the billable activity in US dollars.

CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID is an identifier for the client as set up in the core billing system.

DELIVERY_METHOD.description: Delivery Method indicates how the invoice is sent to the client. E.g. By post, by email, etc.

DIRECT_DEBIT_CASH_ACCOUNT.description: Direct Debit Cash Account is the account id of the cash account from which the invoice amount will be debited.

DIRECT_DEBIT_SLA_DATE.description: Direct Debit SLA is the date on which the direct debit is expected to be taken.

FEE_SCHEDULE_CURRENCY.description: Fee Schedule Currency is the ISO 4217 currency code corresponding to the currency in which the rate card is published.

INVOICE_CURRENCY.description: Invoice Currency is the ISO 4217 currency code corresponding to the currency in which the invoice is to be paid.

INVOICE_DELIVERY_DATE.description: Invoice Delivery Date is the date on which the invoice was sent to the client.

BILLING_FREQUENCY.description: Invoice Frequency indicates how often the invoice is calculated. E.g. Monthly, Quarterly, etc.

BILLABLE_MONTH.description: Represents the billing month for which the invoice is generated. The date typically reflects a day within the billable month.

BILLING_PERIOD.description: Represents the specific date or timestamp associated with the billing period used for invoice calculation.

INVOICE_NUMBER.description: Invoice Number is the unique reference number of the invoice.

INVOICE_SCHEDULE_ID.description: Invoice Schedule Identifier is a unique reference for the schedule under which each invoice is created.

REPORTING_DATE.description: Invoice Update Date is the date on which the invoice was last changed.

MARKET.description: Market is the name of the market or International Central Securities Depositories in which the billable activity has occurred.

PAYMENT_BASIS.description: Payment Basis indicates how the invoice is expected to be paid. e.g. Remittance, Direct Debit.

BILLING_CENTRE.description: Place Of Settlement Code is a 3 digit code corresponding to the settlement location of the holding.

BILLING_CENTRE_NAME.description: Place Of Settlement is the settlement location of the holding.

QUANTITY_IN_ACCOUNT_CURRENCY.description: Quantity (Account Currency) is either the number of charges incurred or the value used in the fee calculation converted to the Account Currency.

QUANTITY_IN_FEE_SCHEDULE_CURRENCY.description: Quantity (Activity Currency) is either the number of charges incurred or the value used in the fee calculation converted to the Activity Currency.

QUANTITY_IN_INVOICE_CURRENCY.description: Quantity (Invoice Currency) is either the number of charges incurred or the value used in the fee calculation converted to the Invoice Currency.

QUANTITY_IN_USD.description: Quantity (USD) is either the number of charges incurred or the value used in the fee calculation converted to US dollars.

REGION.description: Region is the name of the geographical region (if appropriate) in which the billable activity has occurred.

REVISED_FLAG.description: Revised Flag indicates whether or not the invoice has been changed since it was first calculated.

REVISION_NUMBER.description: Revision Number indicates how many times the invoice has been revised.

SALES_TAX_FEE_IN_ACCOUNT_CURRENCY.description: Sales Tax (Account Currency) is the applicable sales tax in the Account Currency.

SALES_TAX_FEE_IN_FEE_CURRENCY.description: Sales Tax (Fee Schedule Currency) is the applicable sales tax in the Fee Schedule Currency.

SALES_TAX_FEE_IN_INVOICE_CURRENCY.description: Sales Tax (Invoice Currency) is the applicable sales tax in the Invoice Currency.

SALES_TAX_FEE_IN_USD.description: Sales Tax (USD) is the applicable sales tax in US Dollars.

TOTAL_FEE_IN_ACCOUNT_CURRENCY.description: Total Fee (Account Currency) is the total charge for the billable activity in the Account Currency.

TOTAL_FEE_IN_FEE_CURRENCY.description: Total Fee (Fee Schedule Currency) is the total charge for the billable activity in the Fee Schedule Currency.

TOTAL_FEE_IN_INVOICE_CURRENCY.description: Total Fee (Invoice Currency) is the total charge for the billable activity in the Invoice Currency.

TOTAL_FEE_IN_USD.description: Total Fee (USD) is the total charge for the billable activity in US Dollars.

INVOICE_YEAR.description: Represents the calendar year in which the custody invoice is generated.

ACCT_NME.description: Account Name is the name that is assigned to the Cash Account and/or the Safekeeping Account. If an Alternate Account Name has been specified for an account it will be displayed as the Account Name.

BR_ID.description: Branch Code is the identifier of the branch for the account. For the Cash Account the branch code is a numeric value and for the Safekeeping Account it is the ISO Country code.

ALTV_CUR_CD.description: Account Base Currency Code is the ISO Currency Code for the account.

ACCT_BASE_NBR.description: Account Base Number is an internal client identifier that is associated to a Safekeeping or Cash Account.

ACCT_BUS_TYP_CD.description: Account Type Code indicates the type of the account. Values are: C (Cash Account), S (Safekeeping Account).

IOD_TIMESTAMP.description: Provides the Timestamp when data is loaded in the Data Lake.
